text:
FOOL:
  If a man's brains were in his heels, wouldn't they be in danger of chilblains?
LEAR:
  Yes, boy.
FOOL:
  Then cheer up, please.
  Your brains will never need slippers, because you haven't got any in your heels.
LEAR:
  Ha, ha, ha!
FOOL:
  You'll see your other daughter treat you kindly, all right.
  She's as like this one as a crab apple is like an apple.
  But I know what I know.
LEAR:
  And what do you know, boy?
FOOL:
  She'll taste as like this one as a crab apple tastes like a crab apple.
  Can you tell me why a man's nose sits in the middle of his face?
